turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise much and many?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can. Our goal today: talk about quantities in daily life, using much and many correctly.

Imagine you are in your kitchen, checking what you have before you go shopping.

One quick question to start: name one thing in your kitchen that you can count, and one thing that you cannot count. Write them in one short line. Then we will see how the quantity words change.
